message:
## Summary

Completes [PRD #151: AI Model Comparison for MCP Platform](https://github.com/vfarcic/dot-ai/issues/151) - Comprehensive evaluation and comparison of 10 AI models across all MCP platform AI interactions.

### Key Achievements

**✅ 10 AI Models Integrated & Evaluated**:
- **Premium Tier**: Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, OpenAI GPT-5, GPT-5 Pro
- **Mid-Tier**: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, xAI Grok-4, Grok-4-Fast-Reasoning, Mistral Large
- **Budget Tier**: DeepSeek-R1 (documented limitations)

**✅ Comprehensive Testing Infrastructure**:
- 779+ evaluation datasets generated across all models and MCP tools
- Complete integration test suite execution for each model
- Extended metrics collection and analysis pipeline

**✅ Platform-Wide Analysis System**:
- Dual-format report generation (JSON + Markdown)
- AI-powered cross-tool performance synthesis
- Multi-dimensional decision matrices (quality, speed, cost, reliability)
- Tool-specific and platform-wide recommendations

**✅ Multi-Provider Embedding Support**:
- Google embedding provider (`text-embedding-004`)
- Mistral embedding provider (`mistral-embed`)
- Independent embedding/chat model provider selection

**✅ Comprehensive Documentation**:
- Complete model selection guide with 10-model comparison
- Provider configuration instructions for all models
- Usage guidelines for different priorities (cost, performance, balanced)

## Test Plan

- [x] All 10 models tested across complete integration test suite
- [x] Extended metrics captured for every AI interaction
- [x] Comparative analysis generated for all tool types
- [x] Platform-wide synthesis system validated
- [x] Multi-provider embedding functionality tested
- [x] Documentation reviewed and updated

## Implementation Details

### Infrastructure Enhancements
- **Model Integration**: Extended Vercel AI SDK provider to support xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, Claude Haiku
- **Evaluation System**: Dual-format report generation (JSON for analysis, Markdown for humans)
- **Model Metadata**: Comprehensive pricing, capabilities, and characteristics data collection
- **Embedding Providers**: Factory pattern for Google/Mistral/OpenAI embedding selection

### Key Findings
- **Top Performers**: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (0.846 overall), Claude Haiku 4.5 (0.836, best value)
- **Tool-Specific Leaders**: Mistral Large (pattern/policy), Claude models (capability/recommendation/remediation)
- **Value Champions**: Grok-4-Fast-Reasoning, Claude Haiku 4.5 (exceptional cost-performance)
- **Production Warnings**: GPT-5 Pro reliability issues, DeepSeek function calling limitations

### Files Changed
- `src/core/vercel-provider.ts` - Multi-provider support (10 models)
- `src/core/embedding-service.ts` - Multi-provider embedding architecture
- `src/core/model-config.ts` - Centralized model configuration
- `src/evaluation/eval-runner.ts` - Dual-format report generation
- `src/evaluation/platform-synthesizer.ts` - Cross-tool analysis system
- `src/evaluation/model-metadata.json` - Comprehensive model data
- `docs/guides/mcp-setup.md` - Updated with 10-model configuration guide

## Breaking Changes

None - All changes are additive with backward compatibility maintained.

**All Milestones Complete** ✅:
- Milestone 1: Test Suite Analysis & Infrastructure Setup ✅

- Milestone 5: Embedding Provider Enhancement ✅

**All Decisions Complete** ✅:
- Decision 1-8: All architectural and implementation decisions finalized
